limitations: Baseline replay classifies the unchanged generator; original PHYS-GPU-1 did not retain every failure record.
Main aggregate field in the raw runner JSON covers its last trajectory only. combined_trajectory_counts explicitly combines all ten trajectory cases.
Controlled branch test proves both roots for 360 updates, not global branch uniqueness during full stress.
Failed-contact reason codes and bounded root probes do not prove physically invalid targets.
Resource-only run has no numerical failure capture or timing samples. Empty metrics are unmeasured, not zero latency.
GTX 970 performance is not target acceptance. Packet packing and CPU oracle fixture costs are outside wrapper submit/consume timing.
